{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute the Pearson correlation and print it exactly as it appears
result = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Print the result to ensure it is captured in output
print(result)

# Now explicitly extract and print the value as a string to ensure it's visible
print(f'Correlation coefficient: {result}')"}
